definitions.meaning: The king's highway, a public road which was under the king's friþ

quotations.old_english: On Wifeles ford; ðonne andlang ðæs friðherpadcs (Icknield Way ?)

source_text: friþ-her[e]paþ, es; m. The king's highway, a public road which was under the king's friþ. [Cf. De pace regia et .iiii. chiminorum vel viarum regalium, Ll. Th. i. 447, 6. Omnes herestrete regis sunt, 519, 11] :-- On Wifeles ford; ðonne andlang ðæs friðherpadcs (Icknield Way ?), C. D. v. 214, 35.
